pack.title: Alpha V4.3.8
pack.summary: Release V4.3.8. 14 change(s) in this update - see the full changelog on the Wiki for details.

launcher.notes: Corvus now looks like macOS System Settings: a sidebar with a search field and coloured icons, and every setting laid out as rounded groups of rows. General opens with your computer account's own name and picture — on macOS read from Directory Services (verified on the developer's Mac); on Windows from the account's FullName and the AccountPicture registry entry, and on Linux from the passwd entry and ~/.face or AccountsService — those two are written to the documented locations but have NOT been run on a real Windows or Linux desktop yet, and fall back to your login name and initials if nothing can be read. Update holds the pack, the app, Aureum, and the auto-update and backup switches; Play moved to General. Nothing about how updates are checked, verified or applied changed. Verified by photographing every pane from the built jar on macOS in English, Japanese and Arabic.
